evals.name: bounded-request-telemetry
evals.prompt: Add structured logging and OpenTelemetry tracing middleware to an HTTP router.
evals.expected_output: Middleware extracting trace ID from request, starting OpenTelemetry span, and attaching trace ID to slog logger context.
assertions: Propagates OpenTelemetry span context across the request lifecycle.
Injects trace_id and span_id into slog handler attributes.
Records request duration, path, and HTTP response status code.

evals.name: span-attributes-and-events
evals.prompt: Record a domain event and domain error on an active OpenTelemetry span during checkout.
evals.expected_output: Using span.SetAttributes, span.AddEvent, and span.RecordError with standard semantic conventions.
assertions: Sets domain attributes following OpenTelemetry semantic conventions.
Records errors using span.RecordError and sets span status to Error.
Avoids storing sensitive data (passwords, card numbers) on span attributes.

evals.name: cardinality-safe-metrics
evals.prompt: Design a Prometheus counter tracking HTTP request counts in a Go web application.
evals.expected_output: Prometheus metric with low-cardinality labels (method, route template, status code).
assertions: Uses route template (e.g. /users/{id}) instead of raw URL (/users/12345) to prevent cardinality explosion.
Does not include user IDs, timestamps, or raw query parameters in labels.
Labels are restricted to method, route, and status_code.
